heroSubtitle: We propose premium care standards for both mother and baby.
postpartumDesc: HappyMom's postpartum care specialists go beyond simple help, taking responsibility for the mother's health recovery and the stable development of the newborn.
newbornGrowth: Growth Management: Recording and managing newborn logs, measuring body temperature, and checking health status.
newbornDev: Development Support: Newborn massage (promoting growth and development, emotional stability, and cranial nerve development).
newbornHygiene: Hygiene Management: Bathing and belly button care, sterilizing bottles, and managing breast pumps.
newbornClothing: Clothing Management: Washing dedicated clothing and bedding for newborns.
maternalBody: Physical Recovery: Support for postpartum edema management and foot baths to promote blood circulation.
maternalBreast: Breastfeeding Specialization: Breast massage (preventing engorgement and pain relief) and breastfeeding posture guidance.
maternalHealing: Healing Support: Sitz bath management for perineal pain relief and wound healing.
maternalNutrition: Nutrition Management: Specialized postpartum meal and nutrition management for mother's recovery.
familyHygiene: Hygiene Environment: Cleaning the baby's room, maintaining a pleasant indoor environment, and kitchen cleanliness.
familySupport: Family Support: Preparing meals and snacks for the husband and older children, and simple laundry management.
familyOrg: Environment management: Daily organization of children's toys and living spaces.
warningDesc: HappyMom's postpartum care specialists are experts responsible for the health of the mother and newborn. They are not general housekeepers, but focus on the mother's recovery and the baby's stability as their top priority.
babysitDesc: So parents can focus on their daily lives with peace of mind, experienced caregivers warmly look after their children.
babysitExpert: Expertise: Placement of experienced specialists who understand infant development stages.
babysitSafety: Safety First: Indoor care you can trust even when parents are away.
babysitBond: Emotional Bond: A warm parenting service that goes beyond simple care to connect with the child.
